mostWorthwhile.text: The calcium-triggered sliding-filament cycle was most worthwhile: the planned pictures distinguish filament sliding from filament shortening and show ATP’s role in the cycle.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the triceps repeated the biceps force-transmission inset, making that passage less distinctive.

surprise.text: Relaxation requires ATP-powered calcium pumping, and the fibre lengthens under an outside pull rather than pushing itself longer.

arbitrary.text: Adding extracellular matrix to make fascicles initially had an uncertain connection to tendon assembly; the result clarified the connective layers. Otherwise, the actions had clear purposes, although most were the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would continue: the progression from molecular pulling to opposing movements at the elbow made the constructions meaningful, despite some repetition.
